questions.stem: A 72-year-old epileptic patient on Phenobarbitone took 10 tablets in the morning. He was drowsy and lethargic when bought to the emergency ward. The elimination of drugs can be enhanced by the following method:

options.label: C
options.text: By giving flumazenil which increases drug metabolism

options.label: D
options.text: By displacing the drug by inducing jaundice

questions.solutionHtml:
Alkalinization of the urine

questions.stem: Barbiturates are useful in neonatal jaundice and contraindicated in acute intermittent porphyria. The reason for this is?

options.label: D

questions.stem: A person was traveling from London to India, and while reaching India, it was daytime, and he had to sleep because of Jet Lag. He consulted a doctor for the same, and the doctor gave him ramelteon. Which of the following is correct regarding Ramelteon?

options.label: D
options.text: Is indicated in generalized anxiety disorder

questions.solutionHtml:
Activates MT1 and MT2 receptors
  • Ramelteon is anagonist at MT1 and MT2 used for insomnia patients and jet lags, patients who have difficulty falling asleep
  • It is an MT1, MT2 melatonin receptor agonist introduced as a new hypnotic class for sleep onset insomnia that does not alter GABAergic neurotransmission or produce the usual BZD-like side effects.


Goodman & Gilman's: The Pharmacological Basis of Therapeutics, 12th Edition, Page Number: 413

questions.stemHtml: What drugs are given at A and B, respectively, to inhibit the given enzymes in the pathway?
questions.solutionHtml:
A- Fomepizole, B- Disulfiram
  • Disulfiram inhibits the enzyme aldehyde dehydrogenase.
  • Fomepizole (4-methyl pyrazole) is a specific inhibitor of alcohol dehydrogenase and the drug of choice for methanol poisoning.


Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 421,423

questions.stem: A 53-year-old Patient named Raj, who has had a H/O intake of moderate amounts of Alcohol for the past 30 years, came for de-addiction. An anti-epileptic drug used in reducing cravings in Chronic Alcoholism is:-
questions.solutionHtml:
Topiramate

  • Topiramate is used off-label for the treatment of Chronic alcoholism.
  • It is a weak carbonic anhydrase inhibitor with broad-spectrum anticonvulsant activity in maximal electroshock, PTZ-induced clonic seizures, and the kindling model.


Lange Katzung, Basic & Clinical Pharmacology, 14th Edition, Page No. 397

questions.stem: Which of these drugs is not used in the maintenance of alcohol deaddiction?
questions.solutionHtml:
Morphine

Morphine is a pain-relieving medicine. It effectively alleviates moderate to severe pain. Morphine is Not used in the maintenance of alcohol deaddiction.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 421,422

Modafinil

Katzung Basic and Clinical Pharmacology 15th Edition, chapter 9, Page Number: 23,28

questions.stem: The most common adverse effect of methyldopa is:
questions.solutionHtml:
Sedation

Sedation is typically used for common diagnostic tests that require prolonged immobilization, such as magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and computed axial tomography (CAT) scanning. Some cases requiring sedation may also necessitate using analgesics to decrease pain associated with a procedure or test.



Essentials Of Medical Pharmacology, By KD Tripathi, 8th Edition, Page Number: 612
